description: This is a C# source code file that defines an abstract test runner class for transactional state storage in Orleans framework. The class contains various asynchronous test methods for verifying storage behaviors such as loading, storing, confirming, canceling, replacing, and batch processing states within a transactional context.

classes.name: TransactionalStateStorageTestRunner<TState>
classes.description: An abstract generic class providing a suite of asynchronous test methods for verifying behaviors of transactional state storage, such as load, store, confirm, cancel, replace, and batch operations in Orleans.

methods.name: FirstTime_Load_ShouldReturnEmptyLoadResponse
methods.description: Test method to verify that loading from an newly created storage returns an empty or default state.

methods.name: StoreWithoutChanges
methods.description: Test method to verify storing without any changes retains the previous state correctly.

methods.name: WrongEtags
methods.description: Test method to verify that storage correctly handles mismatched ETags, preventing unwanted overwrites.

methods.name: ConfirmOne
methods.description: Test method to verify the confirmation of a single pending transaction state updates the committed state appropriately.

methods.name: CancelOne
methods.description: Test method to verify the cancellation of a single pending transaction state reverts the pending state correctly.

methods.name: ReplaceOne
methods.description: Test method to verify replacing the pending state updates the state accordingly.

methods.name: ConfirmOneAndCancelOne
methods.description: Test method to verify actions of confirming one transaction and canceling another in sequence.

methods.name: PrepareMany
methods.description: Test method to prepare multiple pending states and verify their proper storage and retrieval.

methods.name: ConfirmMany
methods.description: Test method to confirm multiple pending states in batch and verify the aggregated state.

methods.name: CancelMany
methods.description: Test method to cancel multiple pending states and verify the resulting state.

methods.name: ReplaceMany
methods.description: Test method to replace multiple pending states with new ones and verify correctness.

methods.name: GrowingBatch
methods.description: Test method that simulates a growing batch of pending states, adding more and verifying the state transitions.

methods.name: ShrinkingBatch
methods.description: Test method to verify the storage behavior when reducing or canceling pending states in a batch.
